mapper.select: select a.*,u.nickname as userName,u.student_id as studentId, CASE WHEN a.type = 'RESOURCE' THEN r.name WHEN a.type = 'VENUE' THEN f.name END AS resourceName, r.image as image, f.location as location from appointment as a left join user as u on a.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN resource AS r ON a.type = 'RESOURCE' AND r.id = a.resource_id LEFT JOIN facility AS f ON a.type = 'VENUE' AND f.id = a.resource_id where a.id=#{id}
